options.name: api_headers
options.description: Headers that are passed to the socketio connection.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The Uptime Kuma password. Only required if no I(api_token) specified and authentication is enabled.

options.name: api_ssl_verify
options.description: true to verify SSL certificates, or false to skip SSL certificate verification, allowing connections to servers with self signed certificates.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How many seconds the client should wait for the connection, an expected event or a server response.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The Uptime Kuma login token. Only required if no I(api_username) and I(api_password) specified and authentication is enabled.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Uptime Kuma URL.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The Uptime Kuma username. Only required if no I(api_token) specified and authentication is enabled.

options.name: api_wait_events
options.description: How many seconds the client should wait for the next event of the same type. There is no way to determine when the last message of a certain type has arrived. Therefore, a timeout is required. If no further message has arrived within this time, it is assumed that it was the last message.

options.name: checkBeta
options.description: True if update check for beta versions should be enabled.

options.name: checkUpdate
options.description: True if update check should be enabled.

options.name: chromeExecutable
options.description: Chrome/Chromium Executable

options.name: disableAuth
options.description: True if authentication should be disabled.

options.name: dnsCache
options.description: True if dns cache should be enabled.

options.name: entryPage
options.description: The entry page. The value requires the prefix "statusPage-". For example, if the slug is "1uhosting", then the entryPage is "statusPage-1uhosting".

options.name: keepDataPeriodDays
options.description: Keep monitor history data for this number of days.

options.name: nscd
options.description: Enable NSCD (Name Service Cache Daemon) for caching all DNS requests

options.name: password
options.description: The Uptime Kuma password. Only required if I(disableAuth) is true.

options.name: primaryBaseURL
options.description: The primary base URL.

options.name: searchEngineIndex
options.description: True if Uptime Kuma should be indexed by search engines.

options.name: serverTimezone
options.description: The server timezone.

options.name: steamAPIKey
options.description: The Steam API key for monitoring a Steam game server.

options.name: tlsExpiryNotifyDays
options.description: HTTPS monitors trigger notification when the TLS certificate expires in the specified days.

options.name: trustProxy
options.description: True to trust 'X-Forwarded-*' headers. If you want to get the correct client IP and your Uptime Kuma is behind such as Nginx or Apache, you should enable this.
